theorems.name: Submission.cmc_fc_gs_helly_no_concentration
theorems.statement: ∀ (μ : ℕ → Measure ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0∞), Λ ≠ ∞ → (∀ j, μ j (Icc a b) ≤ Λ) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (N : Set ℝ), StrictMono φ ∧ N.Countable ∧ ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, s ∉ N → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, μ (φ j) (Icc (s - δ) s) ≤ ε
